name: feature-voting
title: Feature Voting
blurb: Vote-tallying list where users upvote features, each vote increments a live…
description: Compound component (Root, Item, Trigger, Count, Title, Description) for feature voting. Tracks total votes per feature and which features the current user has voted for. Items show vote counts; clicking a trigger toggles user's vote and…
use_when: Feature request boards or priority voting where users upvote and results accumulate live.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices (small vote button targets) or when votes should be anonymous from other viewers.
a11y: Items and triggers are keyboard-accessible buttons. Controlled (value prop) and uncontrolled (defaultValue) modes supported. Data attributes reflect voted state.
